captions.en: Graffitty is a terminal emulator,
with a tiling manager and Chromium.
But if you zoom out, you'll notice
there's much more space to work with.
captions.text: 작업 공간이 훨씬 넓다는 걸 알게 됩니다.

captions.en: Each pane shows CPU, RAM usage,
and agent status.
Stash a pane outside the main view.
captions.text: 창을 메인 뷰 밖으로 치워 둘 수 있습니다.

captions.en: You can return to the main view at any time.
captions.text: 언제든지 메인 뷰로 돌아올 수 있습니다.

captions.en: Or jump back to your previous view
and take a closer look at any pane.
captions.text: 원하는 창을 자세히 볼 수 있습니다.

captions.en: The builtin filetree is synchronised
with the shell's current working directory.
You can edit the file name like editing a vim buffer,
captions.text: vim 버퍼를 편집하듯 파일 이름을 고치고,

captions.en: and save to apply it.
Opening the files opens Neovim,
or Chromium to preview all kinds of media.
captions.text: 온갖 미디어는 Chromium으로 미리 볼 수 있습니다.

captions.en: You can also send file paths to the terminal,
captions.text: 파일 경로를 터미널로 보낼 수도 있어서,

captions.en: allowing you to change directory or open files.
captions.text: 디렉터리를 옮기거나 파일을 열 수 있습니다.

captions.en: Get creative with Chromium.
It's a versatile viewer that handles things
traditional terminals often need workarounds for.
captions.text: 기존 터미널에선 우회가 필요했던 일도 해냅니다.

captions.en: For example, use the MarkdownPreview plugin
in Neovim to open Graffitty Chromium.
Now you have a live Markdown preview
right inside your terminal.
Ask Claude to explain with a diagram.
Graffitty Chromium will open right beside your terminal.
captions.text: Graffitty Chromium이 터미널 바로 옆에 열립니다.

captions.en: Multiple agents can each use
an isolated Chromium session,
captions.text: 격리된 Chromium 세션을 쓸 수 있어서

captions.en: so they can run end-to-end tests in parallel.
captions.text: end-to-end 테스트를 병렬로 돌릴 수 있습니다.

captions.en: You can also use Chromium's native interface
in a separate window.
Closing that window doesn't close Chromium.
captions.text: 그 창을 닫아도 Chromium은 꺼지지 않고,

captions.en: It simply brings the same chromium back into Graffitty.
One thing I find frustrating about agentic coding
captions.text: AI 에이전트로 코딩할 때 제가 답답했던 점은

captions.en: is how quickly agents can open a jumble of windows.
captions.text: 에이전트가 순식간에 창을 잔뜩 열어 버린다는 겁니다.

captions.en: They get in the way, steal focus,
and make it hard to tell which agent is using which browser.
captions.text: 어떤 에이전트가 어떤 브라우저를 쓰는지 알기 어렵죠.

captions.en: That's why Graffitty shows clear ownership
with a connecting line.
You can move chromiums out of the main view
and still see who's using them.
The down arrow gives you a summary of every tab,
captions.text: 아래 화살표 버튼은 모든 탭의 요약을 보여 줍니다.

captions.en: including its panes, CPU and RAM usage,
captions.text: 각 탭의 창, CPU와 RAM 사용량,

captions.en: and agent status.
Type to fuzzy search tab and pane titles.
captions.text: 입력해서 탭과 창 제목을 퍼지 검색할 수 있습니다.

captions.en: Aren't you already used to Vim's command line?
The same thing is here,
with a fuzzy finder built in.
You no longer have to keep
every terminal feature as a key map.
captions.text: 키 매핑을 만들어 둘 필요가 없습니다.

captions.en: Search commands, switch tabs, or jump to a pane.
captions.text: 명령을 검색하고, 탭을 바꾸고, 창으로 이동하세요.

captions.en: Just like tmux keeps your session alive
on an SSH server,
you can detach from Graffitty
and attach again any time.
It even has mobile clients,
so you can code wherever you are.
Let me explain how the graph feature works.
Each terminal pane can advertise itself as a node,
captions.text: 각 터미널 창은 자신을 노드로 등록할 수 있어서,

captions.en: so it can queue messages to another pane.
captions.text: 다른 창에게 보낼 메시지를 큐에 넣을 수 있습니다.

captions.en: For example, Codex on the left implements a feature
captions.text: 예를 들어 왼쪽의 Codex가 기능을 구현하고

captions.en: and sends its work to Claude in the middle.
Claude only sends to the Slack node
when a condition is met
that the user needs to know about.
Now ask Codex to implement the website.
When Codex finishes,
Claude receives its session and checks the work.
captions.text: Claude가 그 세션을 받아 결과를 검토합니다.

captions.en: Claude finds missing requirements
and sends the review to Slack.
Graph is very useful when you want
to quickly prototype a pipeline.
This SystemOne node that calls
the JEV decision model in the middle
will route the session for you
based on your question!
The parallel node waits
until every agent finishes.
Once all three finish,
it sends their results and session references
together to the reviewer.
You can even make your own custom node
captions.text: 나만의 커스텀 노드도 만들 수 있습니다.

captions.en: very easily with Graffitty Graph Protocol.
captions.text: Graffitty Graph Protocol을 쓰면 아주 쉽죠.

captions.en: First, let's use the Payload Inspector node,
captions.text: 먼저 Payload Inspector 노드를 써 보겠습니다.

captions.en: which shows what data are sent through the graph.
captions.text: 그래프로 어떤 데이터가 오가는지 보여 주는 노드입니다.

captions.en: It sends just enough information
for the next node to process,
like the session file path and the last message.
captions.text: 세션 파일 경로와 마지막 메시지 같은 것들이죠.

captions.en: Here is a minimal Python example
that uses the GGP protocol
to convert the data to uppercase.
Define the input and output ports,
process the data, and send it on.
Run it.
Connect the nodes,
Send the message.
This node converts the message to uppercase.
The Payload Inspector shows the result.
That's it.
This makes your graph pipeline versatile.
captions.text: 그래프 파이프라인을 다양하게 활용할 수 있습니다.

captions.en: For example, create a simple watcher node
captions.text: 예를 들어 간단한 감시 노드를 만들어

captions.en: that triggers your agent when a condition is met.
captions.text: 조건이 충족되면 에이전트를 실행할 수 있죠.

captions.en: Connect the watcher to Claude.
A new email arrives,
and Claude makes a podcast just as it's told to!
